Want to Build a One-of-a-Kind Company? Ask Peter Thiel
sources.venue: The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania
sources.quote_checked: You always think competition is for winners | You often lose sight of building things that are one-of-a-kind, different and truly valuable | If you are copying these people, you are not learning from them | From the inside, I would argue monopoly is always a good thing | The next Bill Gates will not start an operating system | Often when we use the word luck, we should instead just be thinking a little bit harder
